findings.evidence: The reveal barrier compares its reread with the coordinator's earlier snapshot rather than the transaction-owned advisory authority bound into the retrieved packet, permitting an A-to-B-to-A race.
findings.correction_outcome: Carry transaction-owned advisory authority through the server-only retrieval result/currentness boundary and compare reveal state to that exact authority; prove A-to-B-to-A is withheld without answer or conversation append.

findings.evidence: The 29-second timestamp is carried to dispatch but does not cancel or refuse retrieval, currentness, advisory reread, final authorization, conversation append, or publication after expiry.
findings.correction_outcome: Enforce one deadline-linked budget through all stages and refuse publication when expired; prove expiry during retrieval and reveal revalidation produces no answer or conversation append.

findings.evidence: Syntax, invalid operation, and contract-invalid selection failures collapse into InvalidSelection and all trigger repair; valid JSON with semantic or handle violations can receive a second stream.
findings.correction_outcome: Classify only bounded local syntax failures as repairable, carry the bounded invalid response and closed syntax category to repair, and refuse all semantic/handle/fingerprint/evidence/citation failures without repair.

independence: Independent read-only quality review; no implementation, test, lifecycle, staging, commit, or history mutation was performed.
